Claim 1 (Currently amended): A speaker comprising a permanent magnet (2), and a coil (8) positioned around the permanent magnet and attached to a membrane (10), wherein the membrane (10) comprises an elastomer of thickness less than 0.3mm and with a Young's modulus below __80 MPa__.

Claim 2 (Currently amended): A speaker as claimed in claim 1, wherein the elastomer (10) comprises a silicone.

Claim 5 (Currently amended): A speaker as claimed in any preceding claim, wherein the membrane (10) comprises a flat central region and a supporting edge region, and wherein the speaker further comprises a stiffening element (16) on the flat central region on the opposite side of the membrane (10) to the coil (8), and wherein the stiffening element (16) is formed of a material with a Young's modulus greater than __80 MPa__.

Claim 10 (Currently amended): A method of manufacturing a speaker, comprising: forming a membrane (10) from an elastomer, wherein the membrane has thickness less than 0.3mm and a Young's modulus below __80 MPa__; attaching a coil (8) to the membrane; and assembling the speaker by suspending the membrane (10), such that the coil (8) is positioned around a permanent magnet (2).

Claim 11 (Currently amended): A method as claimed in claim 10, wherein the elastomer (10) comprises silicone.
